EQ001.question: Extract every explicit business rule, decision rule, validation rule, policy, threshold, or condition in the BRD that could affect implementation effort.

answer.rule_statement: All mandatory identity and employment documents must be present before verification can be completed.
An employee requiring privileged system access requires designated IT access approval in addition to HR approval.
A request with missing mandatory information shall be placed on hold and returned to the requestor.
Every approval, rejection and return decision shall include a timestamp and decision-maker identity.
Access provisioning shall not begin until required HR and Compliance approvals are recorded.
A rejection shall require a reason and shall close the active workflow unless reopened by an authorized role.
Only authorized users may view or download documents containing personal employee information.
Overdue onboarding tasks shall trigger reminders according to the configured SLA schedule.

EQ002.question: Extract every Future State Business Requirements mentioned in the document .

answer.rule_statement: The solution shall allow authorized Hiring Managers and HR Operations users to create, save and submit a new employee onboarding request through a web-based interface.
The solution shall support upload of identity evidence, employment contracts, tax documents, certifications and other configured onboarding documents.
The solution shall verify that mandatory identity and employment documents for the selected employee type and jurisdiction are available before verification can be completed.
The solution shall route onboarding tasks to HR Operations, Compliance, IT Access and Facilities according to configured role, location and employment rules.
Authorized approvers shall be able to approve, reject or return an onboarding request for additional information, with mandatory comments where configured.

EQ003.question: Extract every explicit functional requirement from the BRD. Capture the requested capability, actor when stated, workflow or trigger when stated, integrations or APIs when stated, and source reference.

answer.capability: Create, save as draft, edit and submit an employee onboarding request.
Capture employee, employment, manager, location, start date, role and department information.
Upload, classify, preview, replace and download onboarding supporting documents.
Validate mandatory employee fields and required identity or employment documents before submission.
Assign and reassign onboarding tasks to authorized users or groups.
Record approve, reject, return and request-information decisions.
Display onboarding stage, pending tasks, owner and aging.
Send email notifications based on configurable onboarding events.
Search onboarding requests using request ID, employee name, department, status and date range.
Generate onboarding volume, status, aging and SLA reports.
Export authorized onboarding report results to a standard downloadable format.
Capture a complete audit history for each onboarding request.

EQ004.question: Extract every explicit non functional requirements mentioned in the document .

answer.requirement: The production solution shall target 99.9% monthly service availability, excluding agreed maintenance windows.
For normal operating load, standard application pages shall respond within 3 seconds for 95% of requests.
The solution shall support up to 500 concurrent users and allow future scaling.
Access shall use corporate authentication and role-based authorization with least-privilege principles.
Borrower, financial and collateral information shall be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and organizational privacy requirements.
Credit and workflow events shall be logged with user, timestamp, action, decision and outcome.
Loan processing records shall be retained for seven years unless a different approved schedule applies.
Core user journeys shall support accessible keyboard navigation and readable screen content.

EQ005.question: Extract every explicit acceptance criteria mentioned in the document.

answer.criterion: Given an authorized Hiring Manager, when mandatory employee and employment information is entered, then the user can save and submit an onboarding request.
Given a selected employee type, when the user uploads required identity and employment documents, then each document is recorded against the request.
Given a missing mandatory identity document, when the user attempts to progress the request, then progression is blocked and the missing document is identified.
Given a submitted onboarding request, when role and location workflow rules are evaluated, then the appropriate HR or Compliance task is assigned.
Given an assigned approver, when the approver selects approve, reject or return, then the decision and comments are recorded and the workflow transitions.
Given a configured approval event, when the event occurs, then the intended recipient receives a notification containing the loan application identifier and required action.
Given an authorized user, when the loan application is opened, then stage, owner, aging and outstanding conditions are visible.
Given a saved credit decision, when the audit history is opened, then the user, timestamp, decision and outcome are displayed.
Given search criteria, when the user searches loans, then matching authorized applications are returned and can be filtered.
Given a failed verification, when the request is placed on hold, then the hold reason and responsible owner are recorded.
